title: The Lab Below
logline: Two stickmen follow a glowing panel to a door that was not there before, and find a laboratory hidden under the ground.
synopsis: Ren and Bo walk into a dark tunnel. A panel on the wall wakes up, and Bo is the first to notice the change. A steel door slides open where no door should be, and the pair steps into a lab that has been waiting underground for years.
conflict: Ren wants answers now. Bo wants to turn back. Neither can leave once the door has opened.

characters.name: Ren
characters.personality: Brave and impatient; wants answers. Identity colour: cyan scarf.

characters.name: Bo
characters.personality: Cautious; notices danger first. Identity colour: orange backpack.

scenes.title: Arrival
scenes.summary: The pair walks in from the left toward a glowing wall.
beats: Ren and Bo enter from off-screen left
The camera follows the pair at walking pace

shots.camera: Wide, tracking the pair from behind-left
shots.action: Ren and Bo walk in from off-screen left; footsteps
They stop by the wall; idle breathing

scenes.title: The glow
scenes.summary: Ren spots a panel that lights up as they stand near it.

Ren speaks; Bo steps up beside him
The panel lights up; Bo throws both arms up

shots.action: Ren points at the panel and speaks

shots.camera: Medium on Bo, panel in the background
shots.action: Panel is lit; Bo is surprised

dialogue.speaker: ren
dialogue.text: Bo, look at the wall. It is glowing.

scenes.title: The door

dialogue.speaker: bo

scenes.title: The lab

dialogue.speaker: ren
dialogue.text: We found it. An underground laboratory, hidden for years.
